scope: Practical Phase-1 candidate data for P10-P18. Existing daily/TEV datasets, published snapshots and first/second-round research archives only; estimates are not full audits and no production promotion is authorized.

protocols.name: ether.fi
protocols.cash_pe_reason: DeFi protocol economics are structurally eligible, but the complete Stake, Liquid, Cash, withdrawal, beHYPE and eBTC revenue/cost perimeter is not closed.

revenue_ttm_usd.reason: The local daily archive reports $53,095,936 of trailing-365-day DefiLlama dailyRevenue and is retained as a practical estimate. It is not VERIFIED because the mapping does not close Stake, Liquid, Cash, withdrawal, beHYPE and eBTC payer/beneficiary ledgers or the documented 90%/5%/5% Stake split.

direct_economic_costs_ttm_usd.reason: Node-operator and staker shares are participant payouts, not direct costs. Protocol-borne settlement, security and other external cash costs were not reconstructed; organization operating costs and ETHFI incentives are excluded by PRD.

realized_protocol_losses_ttm_usd.reason: No complete security, slashing, credit-loss, compensation or backstop ledger was retained in the existing archive; missing evidence is not zero.

protocol_earnings_ttm_usd.source: Derived only after ether.fi revenue, direct-cost and realized-loss candidates close
protocol_earnings_ttm_usd.reason: Protocol Revenue, Direct Economic Costs and Realized Protocol Losses are not simultaneously available; no missing component is defaulted to zero.

dividends_ttm_usd.reason: A verified wallet transferred 7,836,265.59 ETHFI to the mainnet sETHFI contract, but acquisition/funding provenance, USD basis, L2 synchronization, eligibility and final holder claimability are incomplete.

repurchases_ttm_usd.window: Observed target-TTM subset: 95 dated records from 2025-07-25 through 2026-03-01; no records after 2026-03-01
repurchases_ttm_usd.reason: The retained records identify 95 ETHFI buyback-address inflow days and publisher-valued consideration of $12,789,757.32 inside the target TTM. It remains ESTIMATED because address inflow classification, event-time prices, order ownership, sell assets, fees and Treasury funding are not fully reconciled; the conditional $50m authorization is excluded.

qualifying_fee_burns_ttm_usd.reason: The boundary supply decrease was 1,464,001 ETHFI while the named wallet sent 1,464,000 ETHFI to the zero address. The 1 ETHFI difference, complete mint/burn ledger and fee-funding lineage are unresolved, so no USD fee burn is promoted.

protocols.name: Fluid
protocols.cash_pe_reason: Fluid is a DeFi protocol, but Liquidity, Lending/Vaults, DEX, StETH Redemption, JupLend and Venus Flux must close on a common payer/beneficiary/cost basis.

revenue_ttm_usd.window: Legacy published trailing 365 days, snapshot generated 2026-03-21
revenue_ttm_usd.reason: The older published snapshot's $12,380,928 revenue value is retained as a practical TTM estimate. It is distinct from the rejected $4,745,308 buyback amountUsd field, but complete lender/LP/partner/referral pass-through and JupLend/Venus Flux perimeter closure are still missing.

direct_economic_costs_ttm_usd.reason: Oracle, keeper, necessary settlement and other protocol-borne external cash costs were not reconstructed. Grants, partner incentives and FLUID issuance are not direct cash costs under the PRD.

realized_protocol_losses_ttm_usd.window: Single Resolv-related incident reported in May 2026, within target TTM [2025-07-23T21:16:34Z,2026-07-23T21:16:34Z); exact recognition date and recovery basis not frozen
realized_protocol_losses_ttm_usd.reason: Fluid governance described approximately $21m of Resolv-related bad debt. This is an official rounded estimate suitable only as a Phase-1 candidate; exact bearer, recovery, execution and recognition ledgers are still required before VERIFIED status.

protocol_earnings_ttm_usd.source: Derived only after Fluid revenue, direct-cost and realized-loss candidates close
protocol_earnings_ttm_usd.reason: Protocol Revenue, direct costs and the Resolv loss cannot yet be combined without inventing missing values or double-counting Liquidity-layer charges.

dividends_ttm_usd.reason: The accepted research identifies an executed Treasury/reserve buyback mechanism but no qualifying pro-rata holder distribution. Bought FLUID held as inventory is not a dividend.

repurchases_ttm_usd.reason: The official API reports 125 executed fill rows, 104 transactions, 1,306,296.831064963095675540 FLUID and $4,745,304.885739369236502633 in publisher-valued amountUsd; the first transaction has independent chain evidence. The numeric candidate uses the publisher valuation, not reconstructed cash consideration, so it remains ESTIMATED.

qualifying_fee_burns_ttm_usd.reason: The identified capital-return mechanism is Treasury/reserve repurchase, not irreversible fee-funded retirement. Treasury inventory, governance discretion and supply-point observations are excluded from qualifying fee burns.

protocols.name: GMX
protocols.cash_pe_reason: The trading protocol is eligible, but active/legacy chains, fee-receiver pass-through, oracle/keeper costs and risk losses are not closed for TTM.

revenue_ttm_usd.reason: The published $13,247,188 TTM value is retained as an indicative protocol-revenue estimate rather than discarded. The current 63% pool/37% receiver rule, actual receiver receipts, referrals, rebates/refunds, third-party pass-through and active/legacy chain coverage are not fully reconciled.

direct_economic_costs_ttm_usd.reason: Actual external Chainlink, oracle, keeper and necessary service payments borne by GMX are not reconciled. The documented 10% allocation is a routing rule, not an expense amount.

realized_protocol_losses_ttm_usd.reason: No complete security, credit, compensation or backstop loss ledger is present in the existing package; missing loss data is not zero.

protocol_earnings_ttm_usd.source: Derived only after GMX revenue, direct-cost and realized-loss candidates close
protocol_earnings_ttm_usd.reason: Receiver revenue is not the same as retained revenue, and operating costs/losses remain incomplete; Cash P/E cannot yet be calculated.

dividends_ttm_usd.window: Approximate trailing 12 monthly records from 2025-03 through partial 2026-02; latest month contains 12 days
dividends_ttm_usd.reason: The local holder-revenue series sums to $17,058,614 over the latest 12 monthly records and is retained as an estimated fee-funded holder distribution. It is not VERIFIED cash received: the last month is partial, the adapter uses a legacy staking-reward methodology, and official current materials say bought GMX accumulates in Treasury while distribution is suspended.

repurchases_ttm_usd.window: Official API-tracked weeks 2026-03-04 through 2026-07-22 within the target TTM
repurchases_ttm_usd.reason: Arbitrum reports 371,941 GMX accrued across 21 weeks, while Avalanche and MegaETH report zero. Accrued units do not prove market-purchase consideration, Treasury receipt or final disposition.

qualifying_fee_burns_ttm_usd.reason: The current documented mechanism accumulates bought GMX in Treasury while distribution is suspended. Treasury accumulation is not an irreversible fee-funded burn, so no separate qualifying burn is recorded.

protocols.name: Hyperliquid
protocols.cash_pe_reason: PRD locks HYPE to a trading-protocol economic perimeter, but HIP-3, HIP-4 Outcomes, HyperCore lending, HLP, AF and fee-recipient coverage must be reconciled.

revenue_ttm_usd.reason: The published $792,146,570 TTM total is retained as an indicative revenue estimate. It is not VERIFIED because discounts, rebates, referral/builder/deployer receipts, HLP allocations, HIP-3/HIP-4 Outcomes and lending supplier pass-through are not fully closed.

direct_economic_costs_ttm_usd.reason: No entity-scoped protocol-borne cash settlement/service-cost ledger is available. HYPE staking, validator and contributor issuance is excluded from cash costs and disclosed separately as supply risk.

realized_protocol_losses_ttm_usd.reason: Outcome settlement, lending credit/liquidation, HLP and security-loss ledgers are incomplete; no missing loss is defaulted to zero.

protocol_earnings_ttm_usd.source: Derived only after Hyperliquid revenue, direct-cost and realized-loss candidates close
protocol_earnings_ttm_usd.reason: The PRD permits HYPE Cash P/E only when protocol revenue and costs close; AF balances, entryNtl and HLP PnL are not substitutes for earnings.

dividends_ttm_usd.reason: No qualifying passive HYPE dividend mechanism was identified in the accepted research. Staking rewards require active participation, and Assistance Fund purchases are classified under repurchases rather than dividends.

repurchases_ttm_usd.window: Trailing record window 2025-03-21 through 2026-03-20; 363 daily records
repurchases_ttm_usd.source: data/protocols/hype/tev-records.json (DefiLlama dailyHoldersRevenue labeled buyback_burn); round2-audit/P13-hype/streamlined/economic-review.md and evidence-map.json:AF diagnostics
repurchases_ttm_usd.reason: The local Assistance Fund series sums to $918,600,640 across its latest 365-day boundary and is retained as estimated fee-funded purchase value. It is not VERIFIED because two days are absent, the series is third-party mapped, and AF fills, fee-source reconciliation and final burn transition are incomplete. The same value is not repeated under qualifying fee burns.

qualifying_fee_burns_ttm_usd.reason: AF governance labels and HyperEVM burn mechanics do not provide complete acquisition-lot, raw-supply, fee-source and event-time valuation ledgers. The estimated AF purchase value is recorded once under repurchases and is not duplicated here; irreversible retirement still requires separate closure.

protocols.name: Jito
protocols.cash_pe_reason: Jito is a DeFi/MEV protocol, but versioned stake-pool, TipRouter, Block Engine, BAM subsidy and restaking routes require common-window gross and participant-payout closure.

revenue_ttm_usd.reason: The published $14,662,309 TTM value is retained as an indicative revenue estimate. JIP-25 and JIP-31 routing changes, complete receipts, validator/staker/restaker/operator payouts and subsidy-lot origins remain unclosed.

direct_economic_costs_ttm_usd.reason: The BAM subsidy is participant pass-through, not a second direct cost. Protocol-borne cash service and settlement costs are not reconstructed; Foundation organization costs and JTO issuance are excluded.

realized_protocol_losses_ttm_usd.reason: JIP-20 is a routing correction with no expected DAO-revenue change, not a realized loss after corrected retention. No complete independent security/risk-loss ledger exists.

protocol_earnings_ttm_usd.source: Derived only after Jito revenue, direct-cost and realized-loss candidates close
protocol_earnings_ttm_usd.reason: DAO retained revenue and complete direct costs/losses are unavailable; the existing test value cannot support Cash P/E.

dividends_ttm_usd.reason: Ordinary JTO governance ownership is not a passive dividend right. Restaker eligibility routes require separate participation and are not classified as universal holder dividends.

repurchases_ttm_usd.window: Official aggregate through cutoff; exact purchase dates and complete TTM fill coverage not frozen
repurchases_ttm_usd.reason: JIP-26's CSD acquisition is not established as an ordinary-holder capital return: execution wallets, fills, receipts, exact dates and retirement/distribution are missing, and Treasury/CSD inventory is excluded. JIP-37 matching buybacks are proposal-only.

qualifying_fee_burns_ttm_usd.reason: CSD-acquired or Treasury-held JTO is inventory, not irreversible retirement. No qualifying fee-funded JTO burn mechanism was identified in the accepted research.

protocols.name: JustLend
protocols.cash_pe_reason: The lending protocol is structurally eligible, but V1/V2/SBM reserve-factor epochs, sTRX/Energy Rental routes and Risk DAO losses are not closed.

revenue_ttm_usd.reason: Borrower interest, supplier interest, effective reserve factors, flash/liquidation fees, refunds and beneficiaries are not reconstructed across all markets. sTRX/Energy Rental yield is not automatically JST protocol revenue.

direct_economic_costs_ttm_usd.reason: Supplier interest and liquidator incentives are participant payouts, not direct costs. Protocol-borne necessary settlement/service costs are not available; JST mining and grants are excluded from cash costs.

realized_protocol_losses_ttm_usd.reason: Bad-debt, Risk DAO, compensation and collateral-disposition loss ledgers are incomplete; missing realized losses are not recorded as zero.

protocol_earnings_ttm_usd.source: Derived only after JustLend revenue, direct-cost and realized-loss candidates close
protocol_earnings_ttm_usd.reason: Protocol Revenue and direct loss/cost components are unavailable on a common beneficiary and window basis.

dividends_ttm_usd.reason: No verified pro-rata cash/token distribution to ordinary JST holders was reconstructed. sTRX holder yield and program retirements are not JST dividends.

repurchases_ttm_usd.reason: The archive verifies 1,604,586,131 JST transferred to the registered black-hole address, but not market-purchase funding, consideration, fills or USD pricing. Retirement units are not repurchase cash.

qualifying_fee_burns_ttm_usd.reason: The verified 1,604,586,131 JST is address-level retirement only. Contract totalSupply reduction, fee source, market purchase and event-time USD value are not proven.

protocols.name: Kamino Finance
protocols.cash_pe_reason: Kamino is a DeFi protocol, but K-Lend, Liquidity, KVault curator, referral/host and Multiply economics are not closed on a common TTM basis.

revenue_ttm_usd.window: Published TTM/annualized snapshot observed 2026-07-24; underlying short-window mapping not frozen
revenue_ttm_usd.reason: The published $12,445,934 value is retained as a practical indicative estimate. It may annualize short-window or third-party fee data and does not fully reconcile products, recipients, reserve configurations, curator/referral shares or pass-through.

direct_economic_costs_ttm_usd.reason: Supplier, LP, curator, referral and host amounts are pass-through. Necessary protocol-borne settlement/service costs are not reconstructed; KMNO Seasons/farm/grant issuance is excluded from cash costs.

realized_protocol_losses_ttm_usd.reason: Security, K-Lend credit/bad-debt, collateral-disposition, compensation and backstop loss ledgers are incomplete.

protocol_earnings_ttm_usd.source: Derived only after Kamino revenue, direct-cost and realized-loss candidates close
protocol_earnings_ttm_usd.reason: The rejected annualized revenue and missing direct costs/losses cannot support Protocol Earnings or Cash P/E.

dividends_ttm_usd.reason: Seasons rewards, farming rewards and staking boosts are native KMNO incentives excluded by the new methodology, not fee-funded dividends. No qualifying holder dividend mechanism was identified.

repurchases_ttm_usd.reason: No qualifying executed KMNO repurchase mechanism was identified in the accepted research. Native-token Seasons, farm and grant budgets are excluded rather than treated as capital returns.

qualifying_fee_burns_ttm_usd.reason: A point KMNO mint supply is not a period burn, and no qualifying fee-funded irreversible KMNO retirement mechanism was identified in the accepted research.

protocols.name: Lido
protocols.cash_pe_reason: Lido protocol economics are structurally eligible, but Core and V3 fee routes, operator shares, realized relief/loss and Treasury capital allocation need common-window closure.

revenue_ttm_usd.reason: The published $39,449,664 TTM value is retained as an indicative Lido protocol-revenue estimate. It does not fully close the current Core 10% fee split, weighted module/operator shares, DAO Treasury receipts or V3 vault-specific settlements.

direct_economic_costs_ttm_usd.reason: Node-operator/module shares and stETH holder returns are participant payouts, not direct costs. Protocol-borne oracle/settlement/service costs are not reconstructed; organization costs and LDO grants are excluded.

realized_protocol_losses_ttm_usd.reason: A 2,500 stETH Treasury relief transfer and 2,499.99 stETH forwarding leg are verified, leaving 0.01 stETH unreconciled; event-time USD pricing and exact bearer classification are missing. The separate 143.98/144 ETH first-loss figure remains an official claim.

protocol_earnings_ttm_usd.source: Derived only after Lido DAO revenue, direct-cost and realized-loss candidates close
protocol_earnings_ttm_usd.reason: Core/V3 retained revenue and realized relief/loss are not available in aligned USD terms; no missing component is set to zero.

dividends_ttm_usd.reason: LDO provides governance rights, not a universal dividend or redemption claim. stETH holder yield belongs to the staking receipt product and is not an LDO holder dividend.

repurchases_ttm_usd.window: Executed Batch 1 from 2026-06-01T14:34:59Z through 2026-06-12T17:07:46Z within the target TTM
repurchases_ttm_usd.reason: Batch 1 used 1,000 stETH to accumulate LDO in Treasury, but Treasury inventory is not classified as an ordinary-holder capital return under this candidate. No qualifying distributed or retired repurchase amount is recorded.

qualifying_fee_burns_ttm_usd.reason: Batch 1 LDO is Treasury inventory, not burn. NEST remained implementation or vote pending in accepted evidence, so no executed qualifying fee-funded irreversible retirement is recorded.

protocols.name: Mantle
protocols.cash_pe_reason: PRD explicitly locks MNT as an L2/network token for which traditional Cash P/E is not forced. Network revenue, direct network costs and capital returns remain displayable when evidenced.

revenue_ttm_usd.reason: Four fee-vault balances are inventories, not period revenue. Receipt/event replay, withdrawals and internal Treasury sweeps are not reconciled. mETH/cmETH protocol fees are separate product economics and not automatically MNT-holder revenue.

direct_economic_costs_ttm_usd.reason: Ethereum blob/calldata, post-Arsia DA, proof, sequencer and operator cash costs are not reconciled for TTM. Removed EigenDA costs are not carried forward without evidence; organization costs and MNT incentives are excluded.

realized_protocol_losses_ttm_usd.reason: No complete realized network, bridge, treasury-strategy, compensation or backstop loss ledger was retained. Passed credit facilities and unrealized Treasury changes are not realized losses.

protocol_earnings_ttm_usd.source: PRD section 5 locked treatment for MNT; round2-audit/P18-mnt/formula-registry.json
protocol_earnings_ttm_usd.reason: A traditional protocol Cash P/E denominator is not applied to MNT. Mantle should instead show network revenue and direct network-cost metrics when those amounts become available.

dividends_ttm_usd.reason: MNT has no contractual ownership or profit-participation right, so a universal holder dividend is structurally not applicable. Eligibility-scoped Rewards Station campaigns are not perpetual dividends.

repurchases_ttm_usd.reason: No qualifying executed MNT market repurchase was identified. Governance authorization, Treasury transfers, native-token budgets and credit facilities are excluded from repurchases.

qualifying_fee_burns_ttm_usd.reason: BIT non-conversion, bridge lock/mint/burn, Treasury movement and proposals are excluded. No qualifying fee-funded irreversible MNT supply retirement was identified in the accepted research.
